description: Create a new branch from an existing one

inputSchema.description:
Create a new branch from an existing branch.
- Pass plain branch names (no "refs/heads/"). Example: sourceBranch="master", newBranch="codex/test1".
- When creating pull requests later, use fully-qualified refs (e.g., "refs/heads/codex/test1").

newBranch.description: Name of the new branch to create (without "refs/heads/", e.g., "feature/my-branch")

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository

sourceBranch.description: Name of the branch to copy from (without "refs/heads/", e.g., "master")

name: create_branch
